name: ServiceNow, Inc.
monetization: Sells AI (Now Assist / agentic workflows) as premium-priced SKUs on its enterprise workflow platform; AI annual contract value crossed $1B in Q2 2026.
description_md: ServiceNow runs enterprise workflow software (IT service management, HR, customer service, security operations) and has become one of the two clearest incumbent-SaaS AI monetization stories alongside Salesforce. Its AI portfolio — Now Assist copilots, AI Agents, and the agentic orchestration/governance layer built partly on the $2.85B Moveworks acquisition (announced March 2025) — is sold as premium 'Pro Plus/Enterprise' SKUs, and its AI annual contract value crossed $1B in Q2 2026, up more than 40% quarter over quarter.
ai_monetization_md: AI monetization is upsell into a sticky base: AI ACV passed $1B in Q2 2026 (+>40% q/q), agentic AI production deployments grew ninefold over nine months, and first-time agentic buyers rose 45% y/y. The base it upsells into remains healthy: Q2 2026 subscription revenue was $3.877B (+24.5% y/y), current RPO $13.2B (+21%), 123 deals over $1M of net-new ACV in the quarter, and FY2026 subscription revenue guidance was raised to $15.76–15.78B. Pricing is per-SKU premium plus consumption elements; the company positions AI governance (its AI Control Tower) as a paid differentiator for regulated enterprises.
ai_strategy_md: Be the orchestration and governance layer for enterprise AI agents rather than the model: buy capability (Moveworks $2.85B for agentic assistant/enterprise search) instead of training frontier models, integrate every major model provider underneath, and price AI into premium SKUs that lift ACV per customer. Management's stated goal of $1B AI ACV in 2026 was hit two quarters early, and the pitch to investors is that workflow + governance is where agentic value accrues.
risk_notes_md: AI ACV ($1B) is ~6% of the subscription run-rate — material but not yet the growth engine bulls price in. Seat-based ITSM is precisely the category AI-native challengers and in-house agents threaten; ServiceNow must out-run its own core's disruption. The Moveworks deal went through extended antitrust review, and integrating an acquired agent stack against fast-moving frontier-lab offerings is execution risk. Model costs sit with partners, but so does capability differentiation.
